event.juno_friend.intro: Okay, okay, okay, quick one. Come see the swimming pool. It's a bucket. Wren named it. I made the sign.
event.juno_friend.doing: See? 'Swimming Pool (Official)'. I'm very proud, and the bucket is very wet.
event.juno_friend.wrap: Best pool in Wetherell. Also the only pool. Also a bucket. I'll cherish it.
event.piper_heart4.intro: Last set of the night, and I'm out of ideas. You pick one. Anything. I'll pretend it's mine.
event.piper_heart4.after: {if choice:request.ballad}A ballad! I'll play it slowly and cry with my elbows.{else}{if choice:request.jig}A jig! Feet, take cover. I'm warming up the bow.{else}The parsnip song! My masterpiece! I'll sing it with feeling and a straight face.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_heart6.intro: Down here. The cellar. It's quiet. I'm not hiding. I'm resting my nerves among the barrels.
event.piper_heart6.after: Thank you. The nerves are still here. But they're smaller. They fit in the fiddle case.
event.piper_heart8.intro: Come sit by the stage. I'm writing a song, and I need your help with every line. It's the only way it'll be good.
event.piper_heart8.after: {if choice:chorus.home}'Home' in the chorus. Of course. That's the word that was missing.{else}{if choice:chorus.road}'The road' in the chorus. Yes. Wanderers love a road.{else}'The saloon' in the chorus. A song about the room itself. Brilliant, and a bit cheeky.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_heart10.intro: Tonight I play the song we wrote. I'll start it. After the first verse, I'm stepping off the stage.
event.piper_heart10.outro: {if choice:chorus.home}They sang 'home' back to me. All of them. I didn't play a note.{else}{if choice:chorus.road}They sang the road back to me. Every verse. I only stood and listened.{else}They sang the room back to the room. Even the stool joined in.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_friend.intro: Friday! Come hear the parsnip ballad. It's four verses, and one of them is about the cat.
event.piper_friend.doing: 'Oh, parsnip, parsnip, in the soil...' I'm not done. I'm very close. I'm very dramatic.
event.piper_friend.wrap: That's a chorus! A bad one. Mine. Tell nobody, and come back for the encore.

letter.tilda_bday.subject: A note from the slate
letter.tilda_bday.body: My birthday is soon. I don't make a fuss. If you were to bring a pie, I'd pretend I'd forgotten. -- Tilda
letter.juno_bday.subject: Okay, okay, okay
letter.juno_bday.body: My birthday is soon! I'm not hinting! I've labeled the date in red, twice. Any gift is fine, except kale. -- Juno
letter.juno_thanks.subject: The label
letter.juno_thanks.body: I kept your label. It's on the anvil. Bram hasn't noticed. Bram has noticed. -- Juno
letter.piper_bday.subject: A short verse
letter.piper_bday.body: My birthday's soon. I'm not hinting. I'm humming. A gift of jam would rhyme with 'ham'. -- Piper
letter.piper_thanks.subject: About the request
letter.piper_thanks.body: The song you chose is now the one everybody asks for. It's your fault. Thank you. -- Piper
dlg.tilda.bark.1.0: Mind the step. The cat has opinions.
dlg.tilda.bark.2.0: I'll put it on the slate.
dlg.tilda.bark.3.0: Seeds, string and gossip. All fairly priced.
dlg.tilda.bark.4.0: Marcus owes Odalys an apology and a pie. It's on the slate.
dlg.tilda.bark.5.0: Wren borrowed lemons I never had. I'm not asking.
dlg.tilda.bark.6.0: The bell sounds best at nine. I've tested it.
dlg.tilda.bark.7.0: Browsing is free. So is the tea. Mostly.
dlg.tilda.bark.8.0: Somebody's whistling outside. I like it. I'm suspicious.
dlg.tilda.bark.rain.1.0: Rain on the glass. Best customer I've had all week.
dlg.tilda.bark.storm.1.0: The jars are on the floor. The cat's on the counter.
dlg.tilda.bark.snow.1.0: Snow on the sign. I'm leaving it.
dlg.tilda.bark.wind.1.0: The sign's swinging. Hold your hats, everyone.
dlg.tilda.bark.spring.1.0: Seed season! Everyone wants parsnips on the same morning.
dlg.tilda.bark.summer.1.0: Awning's up. The bell sounds better in shade.
dlg.tilda.bark.fall.1.0: Pie week. The whole street smells like cinnamon and rivalry.
dlg.tilda.bark.winter.1.0: Stove's on. Kettle's on. Come in.
dlg.tilda.bark.morning.1.0: First customer gets the freshest bread and the oldest gossip.
dlg.tilda.bark.evening.1.0: Nearly closing. One more customer, please. I'm not desperate.
dlg.tilda.bark.here.1.0: Everything's for sale except the stool by the stove.
dlg.tilda.bark.here.2.0: Take your time. The dust is in no hurry.
dlg.tilda.bark.sun.1.0: Closed today. I'm a person. It's strange.
dlg.tilda.bark.sat.1.0: Market day. Half the village visits to look at the other half.
dlg.tilda.bark.rare.1.0: I once sold a parrot. It stayed. It's still here.
dlg.tilda.bark.rare.2.0: Kindness is the only stock that rises when given away.
dlg.juno.bark.1.0: Okay, okay, okay, nobody touch the hot thing.
dlg.juno.bark.2.0: Technically it's art. Technically it's also a doorstop.
dlg.juno.bark.3.0: Hammer, tongs, patience. In that order, mostly.
dlg.juno.bark.4.0: I labeled the kettle "Bram's Best Friend".
dlg.juno.bark.5.0: Piper says I talk too fast. I said that was a tempo.
dlg.juno.bark.6.0: That clasp closes! Don't tell Bram I cried.
dlg.juno.bark.7.0: Wren's gossip is floating in again. It smells like cider.
dlg.juno.bark.8.0: Bram said "Hm" to the bucket. It was a good "Hm".
dlg.juno.bark.rain.1.0: Rain on a hot forge! Best sound in the world.
dlg.juno.bark.storm.1.0: Thunder! The anvil rang back. They're old friends.
dlg.juno.bark.snow.1.0: Snow on the sill, glow in the forge. Postcard.
dlg.juno.bark.wind.1.0: Wind blew the ash everywhere. I'm gray to the elbows.
dlg.juno.bark.spring.1.0: Spring means hinges. Every gate in town fell off.
dlg.juno.bark.summer.1.0: Summer forge: a sauna with opinions.
dlg.juno.bark.fall.1.0: Leaves on the roof hiss when they land. Delightful.
dlg.juno.bark.winter.1.0: Winter forge. Warmest room in Wetherell. Ask Bram. He'll nod.
dlg.juno.bark.morning.1.0: Coaxing the fire. Don't talk loud. It startles.
dlg.juno.bark.evening.1.0: Last clasp of the day. Always the hard one.
dlg.juno.bark.here.1.0: Everything's labeled. Some labels are insults. Bram's chair says "Do Not".
dlg.juno.bark.here.2.0: Mind the floor. The tile by the door is "Mister Trip".
dlg.juno.bark.mon.1.0: Closed Mondays. I'm here anyway. Labeling.
dlg.juno.bark.thu.1.0: Thursday: sharpening everything. Even the bucket.
dlg.juno.bark.rare.1.0: I labeled a puddle "Puddle (Ambitious)". It got deeper.
dlg.juno.bark.rare.2.0: Bram taught me patience first. Then where the good tea is hidden.
dlg.piper.bark.1.0: Request anything. I'll probably play something else.
dlg.piper.bark.3.0: You said "turnip", I heard "return it". It rhymes.
dlg.piper.bark.4.0: Juno says I talk too fast. I call it tempo.
dlg.piper.bark.5.0: Wren borrowed my rosin. I'm composing a strongly worded verse.
dlg.piper.bark.6.0: The fiddle's in tune. I'm the one slightly flat.
dlg.piper.bark.7.0: I wrote a song about parsnips. It's a masterpiece. Ask anyone.
dlg.piper.bark.8.0: Somebody hum the second verse. I've forgotten it. Dramatically.
dlg.piper.bark.rain.1.0: Rain's a drummer with strong opinions. I'll play along.
dlg.piper.bark.storm.1.0: Thunder's the bass. I'll take the bridge.
dlg.piper.bark.snow.1.0: Snowfall's the quietest song there is. I'll hum.
dlg.piper.bark.wind.1.0: The wind plays the chimney flat. Confident, though.
dlg.piper.bark.spring.1.0: New season, new songs. Mostly about parsnips.
dlg.piper.bark.summer.1.0: Beach sets! Sand in the strings, salt in the song.
dlg.piper.bark.fall.1.0: Harvest dances! Everyone's feet are louder than the fiddle.
dlg.piper.bark.winter.1.0: Winter ballads. Wool socks and slow bows.
dlg.piper.bark.morning.1.0: Early. My fingers wake around the third cup of tea.
dlg.piper.bark.evening.1.0: Showtime soon. I'm telling the fiddle it's gorgeous.
dlg.piper.bark.here.1.0: Tip jar's on the left. Wren added "And for Wren."
dlg.piper.bark.here.2.0: The stool by the stage is mine. The rest is chaos.
dlg.piper.bark.tue.1.0: Day off. I'm on the beach with a fiddle and crabs.
dlg.piper.bark.fri.1.0: Friday! Everybody wants "the one about the cow".
dlg.piper.bark.rare.1.0: I once played one request for forty minutes. Called an encore.
dlg.piper.bark.rare.2.0: The first time they sang my song, I stopped playing to listen.
dlg.tilda.slate.0: This is the slate. Every small kindness in Wetherell, in chalk. Look. Marcus is two planks ahead of Odalys.
dlg.tilda.slate.1: There's room under your name. What would you like me to write?
dlg.tilda.slate.r0: A thank-you. Plain, honest and very hard to cash. My favorite currency.
dlg.tilda.slate.r1: A joke! On my slate! ...Oh, that's good. I'm laughing in a shop. Don't tell anyone.
dlg.tilda.slate.r2: A promise. I'll write it small and keep it large.
dlg.tilda.hours.0: I count the stock every night. And every night the street is quieter than it was. It's an odd thing for a shopkeeper to notice.
dlg.tilda.hours.1: I tell myself the village isn't shrinking. Then I count again. What do you think?
dlg.tilda.hours.r0: It isn't. ...Say it again, slower. I'd like to put it on the slate in your handwriting.
dlg.tilda.hours.r1: Together. Now that's a plan I'd stock. Bring ideas. And tea.
dlg.tilda.hours.r2: Gently. Yes. Recounting with kindness. I'll try that, and the cat can supervise.
dlg.tilda.card.0: Behind the flour sacks, in a very old tin, lies a recipe card in faded ink.
dlg.tilda.card.1: My mother's pumpkin pie. I've never baked from it. I was afraid I'd get it wrong. What should I do?
dlg.tilda.card.r0: Bake it. Yes. With you in the kitchen, so I can't back out.
dlg.tilda.card.r1: Safe. It's been safe for forty years. That's not a bad record.
dlg.tilda.card.r2: The whole village. ...The pie feud would hate that. I love it.
dlg.juno.label.0: So? What do you say about it? I'll accept any answer except "Hm."
dlg.juno.label.r0: Accepted! You're officially a fixture. I'll sweep around you.
dlg.juno.label.r1: Relabel me! Oh, that's brilliant. "Apprentice (Chaotic)". Stick it on. Right here.
dlg.juno.label.r2: You... you ate it. ...I'm labeling this moment "Do Not Repeat". And then I'll want it repeated.
dlg.juno.strike.0: It's my first piece that's not a copy. A little horseshoe. Look at it. It's lopsided, and I made it, and I hate that I love it.
dlg.juno.strike.1: Do I keep it, or does it go in the barrel?
dlg.juno.strike.r0: Keep it. Yes. Even crooked. Especially crooked.
dlg.juno.strike.r1: Together! You hold the tongs, I'll tap the bend. Okay, okay, okay, let's go.
dlg.juno.strike.r2: Okay, it's very funny. A horseshoe for a three-legged horse. A very proud three-legged horse.
dlg.juno.shoe.0: Bram stands at the far end of the forge. Juno holds out the horseshoe with both hands and does not look up.
dlg.juno.shoe.1: I can't look. Tell me what's happening.
dlg.juno.shoe.r0: ...Thank you. Quiet's good. The anvil's listening too.
dlg.juno.shoe.r1: Wonderful? It's crooked! ...But thank you. I'm going to look up now. Slowly.
dlg.juno.shoe.r2: A hammer. Okay. One more tap. For luck. For me. For crooked things everywhere.
dlg.piper.request.0: The room's waiting. A ballad, a jig, or my masterpiece about parsnips?
dlg.piper.request.r0: A ballad. A sad one. A sad one with a happy ending, at least. Gather round.
dlg.piper.request.r1: A jig! Get your boots! The stool in the corner is going to dance, I can feel it.
dlg.piper.request.r2: The parsnip song! That's a chorus. A bad one. Mine.
dlg.piper.fright.0: I can play for a hundred people and never blink. But tonight, I think they'll know. That I'm not as good as I say I am.
dlg.piper.fright.1: What do I do with that?
dlg.piper.fright.r0: Talk. Okay. I'm scared of silence, and of being quiet. And of being forgotten. There. Now it's on the barrel.
dlg.piper.fright.r1: ...Thank you. Silence is easier when someone shares it.
dlg.piper.fright.r2: A bucket! You're going to drum on a bucket? ...Okay. Okay! Count me in, in four. One, two, three...
dlg.piper.chorus.0: The verse is about someone arriving. The chorus is about where they end up. What is it?
dlg.piper.chorus.r0: Home. ...Oh. Oh, that's it. I've been missing that word for three months.
dlg.piper.chorus.r1: The road. Restless, wide and honest. It rhymes with "code". If you squint.
dlg.piper.chorus.r2: This room! A song about the saloon. The stools will cry.
dlg.tilda.display.ask.0: The window needs something that says "we're open". Five parsnips, nicely lined up. A tidy row sells anything.
dlg.tilda.display.ask.1: You grow the best parsnips in Wetherell. Would you lend me five? I'll put you on the slate for a pie.
dlg.tilda.display.ask.r0: A dear. Five parsnips. I'll clear the sill.
dlg.tilda.display.ask.r1: That's all right. The window will manage. It's patient.
dlg.tilda.display.remind.0: Five parsnips for the window. Nothing fancy. Just a row of honest roots.
dlg.tilda.display.turnin.0: Look at those! The window looks like noon. I'll put it on the slate in big letters. Here's something for your trouble.
dlg.tilda.cauli.ask.0: Cauliflower, dear. Three heads, firm and white. They're for the harvest basket in the window.
dlg.tilda.cauli.ask.1: Everyone says it's a plain vegetable. I say it's a quiet one. Would you grow me three?
dlg.tilda.cauli.ask.r0: Three. Perfect. I'll start a slate entry titled "Quiet Things".
dlg.tilda.cauli.ask.r1: Later is fine. The basket's in no hurry. It has all the time in the world.
dlg.tilda.cauli.remind.0: Three cauliflowers for the harvest basket. Firm ones, if you can.
dlg.tilda.cauli.turnin.0: Oh, those are beauties. White as fresh chalk. Thank you, [player]. I'll put it all on the slate.
dlg.tilda.pie.ask.0: Pie week is coming. I'd like a pumpkin pie in the window, baked by someone who loves baking. Not me. You.
dlg.tilda.pie.ask.1: One pie. Warm, if you can. I'll put a sign beside it that says "Made by a friend".
dlg.tilda.pie.ask.r0: A pie from you, in my window. That's three entries on the slate and a happy tear.
dlg.tilda.pie.ask.r1: Think. A pie is a promise, and a promise deserves a minute.
dlg.tilda.pie.remind.0: One pumpkin pie, for the window. Pie week is coming on, and the shelf is empty.
dlg.tilda.pie.turnin.0: A pie! A real one! Warm, even. It goes in the window, and the whole street will stop. Thank you, dear.
dlg.juno.ore.ask.0: Okay, okay, okay: I'm out of practice iron. Five chunks of ore? I want to smelt something I can ruin freely.
dlg.juno.ore.ask.1: Bram says ruin is a method. I'm testing that.
dlg.juno.ore.ask.r0: Five ore! You're the best. I'll label the pile with your name. It'll say "Hero (Dusty)".
dlg.juno.ore.ask.r1: No worries! The anvil can wait. It never complains. Much.
dlg.juno.ore.remind.0: Five iron ore, to ruin on purpose. It's a tradition. I just started it.
dlg.juno.ore.turnin.0: Ore! Look at it! Gray, lumpy, full of possibility. Thank you! This is for you, and the pile's labeled.
dlg.juno.coal.ask.0: Okay, okay, okay: I need coal. Six pieces. For polishing. The finest finish comes from the worst fire.
dlg.juno.coal.ask.1: I'm making a clasp I'm not allowed to talk about. Can you help?
dlg.juno.coal.ask.r0: Six coals! You're a saint with soot on your boots. I'll make you something small and secret.
dlg.juno.coal.ask.r1: Not now's fine! The clasp's patient. It's practicing its click.
dlg.juno.coal.remind.0: Six pieces of coal, for the secret clasp. It keeps asking when. I tell it soon.
dlg.juno.coal.turnin.0: Coal! Six lovely black lumps. This is the best day. Thank you, [player]. The clasp is blushing.
dlg.juno.gold.ask.0: Okay, okay, okay. This is a big one. I need a gold bar. Just one. It's for my first mark, my own mark.
dlg.juno.gold.ask.1: If you can find one, I'll stamp the first piece with it. I think you should have it.
dlg.juno.gold.ask.r0: A gold bar! For my mark! You're the reason I'm even doing this. Don't tell Bram I cried.
dlg.juno.gold.ask.r1: Look. Slowly. I'll practice being patient. That's the other thing I'm bad at.
dlg.juno.gold.remind.0: One gold bar, for my first mark. I've cleared the corner of the anvil for it.
dlg.juno.gold.turnin.0: Gold. A real bar. I'm holding it, and my hands are shaking. Thank you, [player]. It's the beginning of something.
dlg.piper.strings.ask.0: The fiddle's strings are done for. I need fiber to twist new ones. Five bundles. It's a very low-tech art.
dlg.piper.strings.ask.1: Bring me the fiber, and the next song's on the house. It's not good. It's free.
dlg.piper.strings.ask.r0: Five bundles! You're a roadie in disguise. The fiddle thanks you in advance, in a squeal.
dlg.piper.strings.ask.r1: Not now's fine. The fiddle can wait. It's got a flat sense of time.
dlg.piper.strings.remind.0: Five bundles of fiber for new strings. The fiddle's been whispering about it.
dlg.piper.strings.turnin.0: Fiber! Soft and strong. I'll twist the strings tonight, and the first note will be yours. Thank you!
dlg.piper.flowers.ask.0: Three sunflowers for the stage. A fiddle needs a few stage lights, and a sunflower's the cheapest sun.
dlg.piper.flowers.ask.1: I'd put them by the stool, and play them a very sentimental song.
dlg.piper.flowers.ask.r0: Three sunflowers! A garden for the stage! The stool will be so jealous.
dlg.piper.flowers.ask.r1: Later's fine. The stool can stay boring. It's used to it.
dlg.piper.flowers.remind.0: Three sunflowers for the stage. The stool's waiting, in a very dignified sulk.
dlg.piper.flowers.turnin.0: Sunflowers! They're glorious. The stage looks like a sunrise. I'll write you a verse. It won't rhyme. Thank you, [player].
dlg.piper.juice.ask.0: Two bottles of juice, for the throat. Big gigs ahead. I'd like a gentle, fruity warm-up and a quiet moment of thanks.
dlg.piper.juice.ask.1: Nobody else asks what I'd like to drink. You do. That's why I'm asking you.
dlg.piper.juice.ask.r0: Two bottles! I'll toast the stool, the stage and you. In that order. It's a tradition. Starting now.
dlg.piper.juice.ask.r1: Not yet. The throat can wait. It's a patient instrument.
dlg.piper.juice.remind.0: Two bottles of juice, for the big night. The throat's practicing its thank-you.
dlg.piper.juice.turnin.0: Juice! Two bottles, sweet and cold. That's a chorus. A drinkable one. Thank you, [player]. I'll sing you the first verse.
topic.tilda.gossip: Ask what the village is saying
topic.piper.silence: Ask about the quiet between songs
dlg.react.tilda.spring.d.0: Seed season! The whole village will want parsnips on the same morning. I've cleared the counter and my nerves.
dlg.react.tilda.fall.d.0: Pie week. Everyone's arguing about crust, and everyone's wrong. I'm taking notes in chalk.
dlg.react.tilda.harvest.d.0: First harvest! You grew something. In my window it goes. I'll put you on the slate for a pie.
dlg.react.tilda.wren.d.0: I hear Wren sang something terrible last night. Four people told me. I charged none of them for the gossip.
dlg.react.juno.spring.d.0: Okay, okay, okay, spring! Every gate in town fell off. I've labeled the pile "Opportunity".
dlg.react.juno.summer.d.0: The forge is a sauna with opinions. I stopped wearing sleeves. Bram's pretending not to see.
dlg.react.juno.harvest.d.0: Your first harvest! Okay, okay, okay, tell me every detail. Especially the tools.
dlg.react.juno.bram.d.0: Bram said "Good enough. Better than good." about a repair. I'm having it carved on the anvil.
dlg.react.piper.spring.d.0: New season, new songs! Most are about parsnips. All are better than the last. It's a rule.
dlg.react.piper.winter.d.0: Winter ballads! Wool socks, slow bows, and everyone sits closer. It's my favorite acoustic.
dlg.react.piper.harvest.d.0: You harvested something! I'm writing a verse. It rhymes "crop" with "stop". It almost works.
dlg.react.piper.wren.d.0: Wren's Opening Night! I heard it through three walls. I'm furious it was good.
dlg.social.tilda.joke.good.0: Ha! A joke with good margins. I'll put it on the slate.
dlg.social.tilda.joke.great.0: Oh, that's a good one. I'm laughing in a shop. Don't tell anyone.
dlg.social.tilda.joke.flop.0: Hm? Was that a joke? ...Oh. Ha. I was counting change. Say it again, slower.
dlg.social.tilda.compliment.good.0: That's kind of you. I'll put it in the till, where it can grow.
dlg.social.tilda.compliment.great.0: Oh, my. A compliment that size will need its own shelf. Thank you.
dlg.social.tilda.compliment.flop.0: Oh. You're very kind. I'm not sure what to do with it. Where do I put it?
dlg.social.tilda.advice.great.0: Advice? Ask me anything. First: buy early. Second: pay in kindness. Third: wear a hat in March.
dlg.social.tilda.advice.good.0: My advice? Plant parsnips first. They pay for everything else.
dlg.social.tilda.advice.flop.0: Advice from me? Dear, I sell seeds. I give directions, mostly. I'll try. Where to?
dlg.social.tilda.tease.great.0: Oh, you cheeky thing! I'll put that on the slate. Under "Brave."
dlg.social.tilda.tease.good.0: Ha! Cheeky. A fair price for being fond of me.
dlg.social.tilda.tease.flop.0: Teasing? In my shop? ...I'm choosing to take that as affection. Careful.
dlg.social.juno.joke.good.0: Ha! Good one! Okay, okay, okay, I'm using that on Bram.
dlg.social.juno.joke.great.0: Oh, that's brilliant! I'm going to label it. "Joke (Excellent)."
dlg.social.juno.joke.flop.0: Okay, okay, okay... Was that a joke? ...Oh! Ha. Sorry. The forge is loud.
dlg.social.juno.compliment.good.0: Aw! Thanks! I'm blushing. It's the forge, probably. It's also you.
dlg.social.juno.compliment.great.0: Okay, okay, okay, I'm going to cry! It's soot! It's definitely soot. Thank you!
dlg.social.juno.compliment.flop.0: Oh! Er. Thank you. I wasn't ready. I'm holding a hammer. It's awkward.
dlg.social.juno.advice.good.0: Advice? Okay! Sure. Here's mine: label everything. Twice.
dlg.social.juno.advice.great.0: Advice! I love advice! Okay, okay, okay: don't trust the red one. Always trust the hot one.
dlg.social.juno.advice.flop.0: Advice? Hm. I'd rather find out by burning myself. It's how I learned everything.
dlg.social.juno.tease.great.0: Oh, you wicked thing! Do it again! I'll label it "Excellent Insult."
dlg.social.juno.tease.good.0: Ha! Cheeky! I'll get you back with a very small, very sharp spoon.
dlg.social.juno.tease.flop.0: Okay, okay, okay... I'm not sure if that was funny. I'll decide later. Hm.
dlg.social.piper.joke.good.0: Ha! Nice timing. You'd make a good drummer.
dlg.social.piper.joke.great.0: That's a chorus! Oh, I'm stealing it. I'll say I wrote it.
dlg.social.piper.joke.flop.0: Wait, was that a joke? ...Oh! Ha. Sorry. I was tuning. Say it again, in B flat.
dlg.social.piper.compliment.good.0: Aw, thanks! I'll hum it later. It's a lovely melody, as compliments go.
dlg.social.piper.compliment.great.0: Stop it, you'll make me modest! I can't be modest. It's off-brand.
dlg.social.piper.compliment.flop.0: Oh! Uh. Thank you. I'm not used to speeches without a drum roll.
dlg.social.piper.advice.good.0: Advice? Sure. Never play a request in the key you were asked in. Keep them guessing.
dlg.social.piper.advice.great.0: Advice! Here: always tune before you panic. Panic's worse out of tune.
dlg.social.piper.advice.flop.0: Advice? Hm. I'd rather learn from a wrong note. It stays with you.
dlg.social.piper.tease.great.0: Oh, that's a fine tease! I'll write it into the bridge.
dlg.social.piper.tease.good.0: Ha! Cheeky. I'll answer in a very flat verse.
dlg.social.piper.tease.flop.0: Hm. Funny. I'll remember that during the encore.
dlg.tilda.topic.gossip.0: Pull up the stool. I never gossip. I just keep accurate books of what's said.
dlg.tilda.topic.gossip.1: {Wren's asking for lemons again.|Juno ordered three hundred rivets and a very small spoon.|Piper owes me four sonnets.|Marcus and Odalys are still not speaking over a pie.}
dlg.tilda.topic.gossip.2: I'd say more, but the slate has ears.
dlg.tilda.topic.slate.0: The slate? Every small kindness in Wetherell, in chalk. It's an honor system. Mostly honor.
dlg.tilda.topic.slate.1: Yours is the best page. I won't tell you why. I'll just write more.
dlg.juno.topic.labels.0: Okay, okay, okay, the labels! Come look.
dlg.juno.topic.labels.1: {Tongs: "Not a Back Scratcher".|Bram's chair: "Do Not".|The bucket: "Swimming Pool (Official)".|The anvil: "Sulking, Possibly".}
dlg.juno.topic.labels.2: There's a new one every week. Bram pretends not to read them. He reads them.
dlg.juno.topic.mark.0: My own mark. A small stamp that's only mine. I haven't made it yet.
dlg.juno.topic.mark.1: Okay. Okay. When I do, you'll see it first. That's a promise, and I label my promises.
dlg.piper.topic.request.0: A request! Finally. Let me guess: "something cheerful"?
dlg.piper.topic.request.1: {Here's a jig.|Here's a ballad. It's four minutes of sighing.|Here's the parsnip song.|Here's something I wrote this morning. It has a hiccup.}
dlg.piper.topic.request.2: That's a chorus! Come back after the set. I'll take requests for the encore.
dlg.piper.topic.silence.0: The quiet between songs? I used to fill it. With chatter, with puns, with panic.
dlg.piper.topic.silence.1: With you here, I let it sit. It's the best part of the set. Don't tell the fiddle.
letter.tilda_slate_thanks.subject: About the slate
letter.tilda_slate_thanks.body: Your name's still at the top. Come by when the chalk needs company. -- Tilda
dlg.npc.wren.missed.0: There you are! A whole week without a word. I nearly told the stool your secrets just to have someone to tell.
dlg.npc.hazel.missed.0: Oh. You're back. (I kept your chair. It stayed empty. It was very polite about it.) I'm glad.
dlg.npc.bram.missed.0: ...Hm. A week. Forge was quiet. Hm. Good to see you.
dlg.npc.tilda.missed.0: There you are! I kept your page on the slate warm. The shop's been quiet without you. Mind the cat.
dlg.npc.juno.missed.0: Okay, okay, okay, you're back! I made a clasp for every day you were gone. The pile's a bit embarrassing.
dlg.npc.piper.missed.0: A week! I wrote you a verse for every night. Most are bad. One is about soup. That's a chorus.
dlg.npc.marcus.missed.0: Ah. You're back. The workshop's been quiet. I planed a plank twice, just to hear the sound.
dlg.npc.odalys.missed.0: Welcome back. I trust you've been well. The clinic noticed your absence, in a clinical sort of way.
dlg.npc.felix.missed.0: There you are. The fish were asking after you. Or I was. Hard to tell, at that hour.
dlg.npc.ione.missed.0: Oh, hello again. I kept your place in the book. Nobody read ahead. I checked the margins.
dlg.npc.dorian.missed.0: ...You returned. I had a small mushroom for you, and then I ate it. I'll find another.
dlg.npc.elara.missed.0: Back at last. I've kept a list of questions for you. It's become a short book.
